K-221.title: Beginning Sounds
K-221.instruction: Write the letter that each picture begins with.

K-222.title: Capital and Small Letters
K-222.instruction: Draw a line from each capital letter to its small letter.

K-223.title: Missing Letters
K-223.instruction: Write the missing letters to finish the alphabet.

K-224.title: Missing Sound
K-224.instruction: Write the missing letter to finish each word.

K-225.title: Match Word to Picture
K-225.instruction: Draw a line from each word to the picture it names.

K-226.title: Ending Sounds
K-226.instruction: Write the letter that each picture ends with.

K-227.title: Middle Sounds
K-227.instruction: Write the vowel you hear in the middle of each word.

K-228.title: Sort by Beginning Sound
K-228.instruction: Draw a line from each picture to the letter it begins with.

K-229.title: Find the Letter
K-229.instruction: Circle every letter that matches the one in the box.

K-230.title: Vowels and Consonants
K-230.instruction: Sort each letter into the vowels or the consonants.

K-231.title: Build the Word
K-231.instruction: Use the letters to build the word for each picture.

K-232.title: Rhyming Pairs
K-232.instruction: Draw a line between the two pictures that rhyme.

K-233.title: Count the Syllables
K-233.instruction: Write how many syllables you hear in each word.

K-234.title: Sort by Syllables
K-234.instruction: Draw a line from each picture to its number of syllables.

K-235.title: Sort by Category
K-235.instruction: Draw a line from each picture to the group it belongs to.

beginning-sounds.full: Naming the first sound in each picture builds the letter-sound knowledge at the heart of early reading.

letter-knowledge.full: Recognizing capital and small letters and their order builds the alphabet knowledge early reading is built on.
letter-knowledge.short: Builds letter recognition and alphabet skills.

word-building.full: Listening for each sound and writing the missing letter builds the decoding skills children use to read their first words.

picture-vocabulary.full: Matching printed words to their pictures builds the word-recognition and vocabulary that turns letters into meaning.
picture-vocabulary.short: Builds word recognition and vocabulary skills.

phonological-awareness.full: Hearing the sounds and syllables inside words builds the phonological awareness that fluent reading depends on.
